summary.overview: The "We Group x Capital A - Weekly Catch Up" meeting focused on key updates regarding acquisition targets and financing strategies. Notably, TXG has signed an NDA but has yet to provide financial documents, prompting Andrew's proposal to send Superfly an NDA to advance discussions. Potential acquisitions Bait Shop and Factory 360 are being arranged for meetings, while new targets like Agency B and Center Stage enter the screening phase. The financing discussion revealed a need for approximately £800K in equity to leverage £2.4M in debt, with a proposed deal structure involving a significant upfront payment, earn-out, and share swap. The team emphasized prioritizing larger targets and discussed various financing routes, including potential mezzanine options. Action items were assigned to team members, including chasing TXG for financials and preparing for an upcoming board meeting on financing strategies. Heather is set to arrange meetings with potential targets for the following week.

Discussion on financing revealed a need for approximately £800K in equity to leverage £2.4M in debt, with a proposed deal structure involving 40% upfront payment, 40% earn-out, and 20% share swap. The team prioritized larger targets, with Nick emphasizing the larger EBITDA goals. Action items included chasing TXG for financials and preparing for an upcoming board meeting on financing strategies, with Heather set to arrange meetings for the following week.
